## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed. Reference any related issue.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] The change is scoped to one logical problem.
- [ ] No `.env` files, databases, or build artifacts are committed.
- [ ] No AI attribution or co-author trailers are present.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where behavior or configuration changed.
- [ ] Tests pass locally for the affected suite(s).

## Testing

Describe what you ran and the results, for example:

```bash
cd OnlineFirPortal.backend && npm run test:jest
```

## Notes for reviewers

Anything a reviewer should know: migration requirements, security
implications, behavior changes, or follow-up work.
